page.content:
Aged king who gives away Britain and learns what love was worth.

How King Lear (character) connects

  • Work: King Lear — Lear is the title king of King Lear.
  • Character: Cordelia — Lear's demand for love and Cordelia's 'Nothing' open the tragedy.

What is King Lear (character)?

Lear is the title king who splits his realm between Goneril and Regan, banishes Cordelia, and carries her body in the last scene of the tragedy.

Key threads lead to King Lear and Cordelia.
